shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **解释必要性继续：可用变化与证据保留 / Explanatory necessity through available variation, 8 October 2026.** [新整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-VARIATION-INTEGRATION.md)新增 **45项 Lean 定理／87项含继承审计**，连接合取查询的条件辨认、同一过程内的释放／支持耗尽、终态混同及同事件记录修复。可靠耦合可免去隔离测试；语义可辨认不等于实际已取得证据，记录也不恢复支持。 / Checked content now includes native variation and retained differences. A same-content global description remains viable. Next join supported positive/negative evidence acquisition and calibration to this interface, crediting existing knowledge/learning results. Universal explanatory priority and normative warrant remain open; the first 17-theorem study keeps its original scope.

**解释怎样保留生成中的差异 / Retaining differences through generative activity，2026-10-08：** [解释必要性的持续研究](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#7-从同样的当前结果走向不同的依存)现以45项新 Lean 定理／87项含继承审计接通可用变化、支持消耗、差异丢失与记录形成。/ Available variation may reveal one condition while erasing another; reliable coupling can support identification without isolated tests. A general recovery criterion and a projected recorded process retain the exact limits. 普遍唯一性仍开放，未将认识要求变成行动或操控的普遍要求。

**Continued explanatory-necessity exploration, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s follow-up](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md#持续探索授权--continued-exploration) authorizes ongoing exploration with Lean. [Source assessment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-VARIATION-INTEGRATION.md#8-primary-source-assessment) records selected Pearl text and an abstract-only invariant-prediction comparison; no statistical guarantees, empirical data or external source bytes are imported.

**Available variation → retained evidence, 8 October 2026.** [The explanatory-necessity continuation](EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#7-从同样的当前结果走向不同的依存) connects conjunctive identification to support-consuming release histories, gives a general endpoint-recovery criterion and constructs a faithful recorded extension. Forty-five additional checked theorems / 87 audits retain coupled inference without isolation, impossible unsupported probes and ambiguity after merger. A complete response profile need not be obtainable in one history; storage does not replenish support. This sharpens the knowledge/correspondence requirement for the common foundation without deriving ethical warrant or defeating a global account preserving all these relations. **Next:** supported positive/negative evidence acquisition → calibration and reuse after changes, using existing knowledge and learning mechanisms. / 可用变化与记录形成共同决定后续可辨认的差异；语义恢复、实际取得和有根据的认识各保留条件。

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 完整有限端点回答必须保留可恢复的一步变化内容；整体约束表述可保留相同答案，故内容必要性与解释优先性分开。
C30.claim_en: Exact finite endpoint answers retain recoverable transition content; a global-constraint presentation can preserve the same answers, separating content necessity from explanatory priority.
C30.scope_zh: 首轮有限查询研究完成；17项新 Lean 定理／42项含继承审计。仅可行性不足，粗配置不可组合，保留历史可恢复表示；普遍必要性、实际规律根据及唯一性未证。
C30.scope_en: First finite-query study complete: 17 new Lean theorems / 42 audits including imports. Feasibility-only loss and coarse-carrier failure are retained; history enrichment restores representation. Universal necessity, actual law warrant and uniqueness remain open.

F22.title_zh: 答案恢复、局部分解与历史约束
F22.title_en: Answer recovery, local decomposition and history constraints
F22.claim_zh: 检查任意解释编码中的单步恢复、共同解读下的区别、整体历史的局部重建判准及两个范围反例。
F22.claim_en: Checks singleton recovery from arbitrary description codes, distinctions under shared interpretation, the local reconstruction criterion and two scope counterexamples.
F22.scope_zh: 17项新声明均为空公理依赖；另有25项继承审计。准确回答不被定义为充分解释；端点对应、问题范围与解读显式给定，不推出概率、干预或无限历史。
F22.scope_en: All 17 new declarations have empty axiom dependencies, with 25 inherited audits. Answer accuracy is not defined as sufficient explanation; endpoint correspondence, query scope and interpretation are explicit. No probability, intervention or infinite-history result.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 充分回答须保留与目标有关的差异；可用变化能辨认依存，也会消耗支持或抹去前史差异，可靠耦合和实际记录可改变可恢复性。
C30.claim_en: Adequate answers retain target-relevant differences; available variation can reveal dependencies while consuming support or erasing prior distinctions. Warranted coupling and formed records change recoverability.
C30.scope_zh: 首轮17项定理保留；后续45项新 Lean 定理／87项含继承审计。辨认不等于取得，支持不自动补充；整体约束可保留同内容，普遍解释优先性及规范根据仍开放。
C30.scope_en: First 17-theorem study retained; continuation adds 45 checked theorems / 87 audits including imports. Identifiability is not acquisition, and support need not replenish. Global constraints can preserve the same content; universal explanatory priority and normative warrant remain open.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、可用变化与保留判准
F22.title_en: Relation recovery, available variation and retention criteria
F22.claim_zh: 检查有限端点恢复、合取测试辨认、同过程内释放与支持、共同终态的前史一致性判准，以及保留改变前差异的记录过程。
F22.claim_en: Checks finite-endpoint recovery, conjunctive identification, native release/support histories, predecessor consistency at common endpoints, and a process retaining pre-change distinctions.
F22.scope_zh: 初轮17项声明保持原范围；新35项变化与10项恢复定理均为空公理依赖，连同42项继承审计共87项。任意条件类、可靠耦合、实际支持、固定关系与记录规律分别明示，不推出完整证据取得或唯一基础。
F22.scope_en: Original 17 declarations retain scope; 35 new variation and 10 recovery theorems have empty axiom dependencies, with 42 inherited audits for 87 total. Unrestricted valuations, warranted coupling, available support, fixed relations and record laws are explicit; complete evidence acquisition and unique grounding are not established.
